correctness.rationale: Explicit Fourier integration gives tridiagonal residue-class Gram blocks. Positive definiteness ensures every Schur pivot is positive. Exact recurrence for coefficient-magnitude ratios, together with L=(m+1)|gamma|<=1, gives R_k<L by induction because m(k-1)-L^2(k-m)>=(m-1)k>=0. Eneström–Kakeya then bounds every root strictly by L^(1/m). Exact degree-(m+1) formula gives sharp supremum and exterior zeros precisely at tau>1/(L-1) when L>1; the first m degrees are monomials. 38011 exact-rational finite checks replayed but not substituted for the proof.

General strong exterior asymptotics and ordinary OPUC disk localization do not control finite Sobolev zeros. This distinguishes two structurally different regimes of a standard positive one-harmonic perturbation, rather than adding an arbitrary special case.
